name: install-quest-system
description: Bootstrap quest-system in the current project. Copies all command files to .claude/commands/ so /new-quest, /counsel-quest, /embark, /make-camp, /quest-log, /change-quest, /complete-quest, /summon-witch-doctor, /ask-sages, /counsel-prompt, and /counsel-plan become available. It also installs a stable verifier hook and a project-local permission override so the verification step does not keep triggering ad hoc approval prompts. Run once per project. Safe to re-run — confirms before overwriting.
